document.name: Lutein GS · 23 geometries
document.summary: Lutein GS · 23 geometries. CAS(20e,20o), def2-SVPD, density fitting, M=2000; all 23 final CASSCF and DMRG calculations converged. GS freezes 42 core orbitals. GS and SA4 use different orbital constraints. The source geometry citation is absent from the supplied metadata. BLA is in Angstrom; energies are in Ha.

example_provenance.note: Only observed result fields are restored; missing diagnostics and execution receipts are not inferred.

task_report.analysis_summary: Imported final convergence evidence; full run history is not included.
